refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoMathRound rounds argv[0] to the nearest whole number based on traditional (up on 5) rounding rules.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoMathRound returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the rounding function. If argc is not 1, the returned value will be an error value with value SilikoErrorFunctionArguments.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoMathRound function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
